name: Framelet
tagline: Your photos. Your videos. A little more order.
description: A simple Mac app for going through folders of photos and videos and clearing out the ones you don't want. There's nothing to import: it works right on your folders, and all the analysis happens on your Mac. It never goes online.
features: Many folders, one grid, with a sidebar to view one at a time
Press D to mark, then trash them all in one safe step
Search by what's in a photo: "beach", "people in a car"
Find exact copies, near-identical shots and similar photos
Lift the subject off its background and save it as a PNG
